intro.transcript: Welcome to Puppet Retail. Pick a story, dress your puppets, and make a show with your own voice.

guided.transcript: Story starters, pick a picture, then tell the beginning, middle, and ending.

free.transcript: Free show! Pick your puppets and make up any story you like!

shows.transcript: My shows! Your stories stay right here on this tablet.

pickStory.transcript: Pick a story to act out.

pickStage.transcript: Choose a stage and add something fun to wear or hold.

ready.transcript: Your stage is ready. Tap the red circle when you are ready to tell your story.

micOkay.transcript: Your voice stays on this tablet.

micNo.transcript: The microphone is resting. Your puppet moves will still be saved.

nextBeat.transcript: Wonderful! Here comes the next part.

saved.transcript: Your puppet show is saved on this tablet.

shelfFull.transcript: Your show shelf is full. Erase one old show before saving another.
